user.title: Clever energy surcharge
user.description: Preliminary rate from Energinet day-ahead prices (DK1/DK2 50/50, incl. VAT). Optionally pick an energy sensor that resets every month (e.g. a utility meter with cycle: monthly) to get the preliminary surcharge in DKK.

data_description.energy_entity: Must reset on the 1st of the month and provide last_reset (utility meter).
data_description.threshold: Clever's threshold incl. VAT; the surcharge is the part of the average above it.
data_description.vat_percent: Added to the spot price before comparing.
